scenes.title: Turn defects into accountable repairs
scenes.narration: Welcome to Resgrid Academy. In this lesson, we will turn defects into accountable repairs. A defect reported in chat can be forgotten when it has no work order, owner, approval, or return-to-service record. We will explain the features, the setup decisions, and a practical way to check the result.

scenes.title: A department scenario
scenes.narration: A failed pump test creates a work order, and the engine stays on a safety hold until the repair is approved. Turn a failed check or reported defect into a tracked repair and a documented return to service. The examples in this series use a fictional department and are teaching scenarios, not default settings.

scenes.title: Work Orders
scenes.narration: Work Orders. Repair and maintenance work orders. Create work orders from failed checks or reported defects. Availability also depends on Maintenance, Readiness Pro. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Preventive maintenance
scenes.narration: Preventive maintenance. Recurring maintenance schedules. Schedule routine service for each apparatus. Availability also depends on Readiness Pro, Maintenance. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Maintenance policies and approvals
scenes.narration: Maintenance policies and approvals. Repair approvals and safety holds. Decide who approves repairs and returns equipment to service. Availability also depends on Readiness Pro, Maintenance. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: New Work Order
scenes.narration: New Work Order. Open a work order. Requires the Readiness Pro add-on. Checklists remain available without it. Availability also depends on Maintenance, Readiness Pro. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Maintenance history and reports
scenes.narration: Maintenance history and reports. Maintenance history, repair costs and safety holds. Requires the Readiness Pro add-on. Checklists remain available without it. Availability also depends on Readiness Pro, Maintenance. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Readiness Pro
scenes.narration: Readiness Pro. The Readiness Pro add-on: work orders, preventive maintenance, repair approvals and safety holds. Checklists do not require this add-on. Maintenance needs its module, permissions and active entitlement. Historical evidence and hold release follow owning-module rules. Availability also depends on Readiness Pro. Check access in the target department.

scenes.title: Parts, vendor charges, and approvals
scenes.narration: Work-order operations connect parts, vendor charges, approval requests, and spending policy to a repair. Review policy, reserve a sample part, record its movement and a vendor charge, then request the required approval. Reconcile repair cost and part movement with the work order and approval decision. Confirm availability in the demo department before recording the live workflow.

scenes.title: Preview bulk maintenance changes
scenes.narration: Bulk maintenance tools preview imported rows or assignment changes before applying them. Use the import template or select demo rows, preview the proposed changes, and review the row outcomes. Confirm the preview, current revisions, and the observed result after an authorized demo apply. Confirm availability in the demo department before recording the live workflow.

scenes.title: Configure one useful workflow
scenes.narration: For the training scenario, work in this order. Step 1. Confirm Readiness Pro access, the Maintenance module, and permissions. Step 2. Create a work order from a reported defect and assign responsibility. Step 3. Record corrective work and follow the configured approval and safety-hold process.

scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.narration: Now verify the result. Review the repair history, recorded costs, approval state, and any safety hold. Release follows the owning maintenance workflow. A common problem to watch for: Checklists are available separately from Readiness Pro. Buying maintenance access does not configure the module or approval policy.

scenes.title: Try it with your department
scenes.narration: Your practice task is simple. Track a demo pump-test defect through assignment, repair, review, and documented return to service. Measure unresolved work-order age. Record the result, who owns the follow-up, and when it should be reviewed. Use the linked feature scripts for the detailed screen recording plan.
